_doc: The four arts in the game now (ThuyVanCanon.art): Current, Stone, Hearth and Wind on screen; code_id is the id the code and Tidebreak's kits keep (water, earth, fire, air). Rows as in the other files: id, src, status.

material: what must be at hand (no material, no art). teachers: who teaches it first, each with its own status; peoples [] means any people. Anyone may learn any art from a teacher; no people is locked out and none gets a bonus.
obligation: the debt each use in the open world leaves in the Account. weakens: where the art draws less.

bands: strength by place. reach_scale and knock_scale scale an art's reach and knock; speed_scale and aim_scale are always 1 (the owner's rule: nothing touches speed or aim). The prepared place (Tidebreak's ring) is full strength.

material.text: Moving water of a named channel, lock or reach.

weakens.text: Far from moving water, and in stagnant or fouled water.

material.text: Worked or field stone, underfoot or in hand.

weakens.text: On boards, mud, reeds or water, far from any stone.

material.text: A live coal carried in a covered ember-pot.

who.text: forge and kiln keepers, smiths and potters

weakens.text: In rain or wet without a covered pot, and far from any forge or kiln.

material.text: Open moving air over a pass, a reach or a sail.

obligation.text: A wind called is let go.

weakens.text: Underground, in closed streets, and in a dead calm.

name.text: Away from home: less reach, less knock.
At home, at a bond-site or in a prepared place: full strength.
